content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To lighten dark lips permanently, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Apply a final intensive overnight brightening mask (8 hours)
Step 2. Apply a specialized melanin-inhibiting serum (5 minutes)
Step 3. Steam the lips to open pores for deep treatment (10 minutes)
Step 4. Apply a thick layer of protective zinc oxide balm (2 minutes)
Step 5. Research and purchase a medical-grade lip lightening cream (1 hour)
Step 6. Undergo a professional chemical peel session (45 minutes)
Step 7. Apply a soothing post-peel cooling gel (15 minutes)
Step 8. Schedule a follow-up consultation with the dermatologist (20 minutes)
Step 9. Perform a gentle sugar scrub exfoliation (5 minutes)
Step 10. Purchase organic cold-pressed almond oil (30 minutes)
Step 11. Cleanse the lip area with a pH-balanced wash (2 minutes)
Step 12. Apply a concentrated Vitamin C booster (3 minutes)
Step 13. Massage the lips with almond oil to improve circulation (10 minutes)
Step 14. Apply a high-SPF lip sunscreen (1 minute)
Step 15. Perform a localized spot treatment on darker areas (5 minutes)
Step 16. Drink a large glass of water to hydrate skin cells (5 minutes)
Step 17. Take a supplement containing glutathione (1 minute)
Step 18. Consult with a nutritionist about skin-lightening vitamins (1 hour)
Step 19. Take a "before" photo to track progress (2 minutes)
Step 20. Sterilize a small mixing bowl for DIY treatments (10 minutes)
Step 21. Apply a topical numbing cream for sensitivity (20 minutes)
Step 22. Rest the lips without any products applied (2 hours)
Step 23. Apply a lactic acid prep solution (5 minutes)
Step 24. Wash and dry your hands thoroughly (30 seconds)
Step 25. Apply a turmeric and honey lightening paste (20 minutes)
Step 26. Prepare a clean workspace with fresh towels (5 minutes)
Step 27. Document any adverse reactions in a journal (10 minutes)
Step 28. Patch test the new lightening cream on the inner arm (24 hours)
Step 29. Wait for the initial redness from the treatment to subside (3 days)
Step 30. Set a recurring reminder for daily maintenance (5 minutes)
